changeSet.comment: nexus.quarantine_restore_chunks restores a chunk with metadata holding only the CHUNK keys of the key table (chunk_text_hash, embedding_model, derived from the chash and embedding_model columns) and judges the reattach plan from the quarantine copy before the move, so a restore with reattach still attaches in the same call while no document key returns to the live collection; a restore with reattach off marks the verdict row of a chunk whose forward owner link it drops with reason owner_link_dropped (nexus-l003p, RDR-236 Phase 4). A ninth parameter, p_rivals, carries the whole-selection rival verdict of a restore that spans several quarantine siblings, so the refusal of two versions of one position holds across them in one call. One function dropped and created, and its grant. No data effect.
